text: I dated this one girl, and I told her that I loved her, and she said she wasn't sure. She strung me along for almost two years. It was brutal.

text: Yeah, it would have been kinder. Will, you're up. Oh, that's me. Did you let Will Wheaton get in your head? He's evil. He plays evil mind games. Did you use my email? Well, if he does, don't believe him. He's not above playing the dead meatball card.

text: Enjoy the accolades now, Will Wheaton. Like your time on Star Trek Next Generation.
